data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'Christos' meaning 'anointed one' and 'phoros' meaning 'bearer'. This name was given to Christians in ancient Greece who carried the teachings of Christ. The name Kristoforo carries the meaning “Christ-bearer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kristoforo usually hope their child will grow to embody christ-bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
